items.title: Awesome Selfhosted
items.content_text:
### Software / Analytics

*   [ANALOG (⭐21)](https://github.com/orangecoloured/analog) - A minimal analytics tool. Tracks events in a span of 10-30 days. `MIT` `Nodejs/Docker`

### Software / Blogging Platforms

*   [Ech0](https://echo.soopy.cn/) - Lightweight federated publishing platform focused on personal idea sharing (documentation in Chinese). ([Demo](https://memo.vaaat.com/), [Source Code (⭐930)](https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker/K8S`

### Software / File Transfer - Web-based File Managers

*   [slcl](https://gitea.privatedns.org/xavi/slcl) - Simple and lightweight web cloud storage. ([Source Code](https://codeberg.org/xavidcr/slcl)) `AGPL-3.0` `C`

items.title: Awesome Nix
items.content_text:
### Command-Line Tools / Discovery

*   [nixos-cli (⭐336)](https://github.com/nix-community/nixos-cli) - Configurable all-in-one CLI for common NixOS tools with an emphasis on improved user experience.
*   [optnix](https://git.sr.ht/~watersucks/optnix) - A terminal-based options searcher for Nix module systems.

### Overlays / Webinterface

*   [neovim-nightly-overlay (⭐387)](https://github.com/nix-community/neovim-nightly-overlay) - Daily bumped Neovim nightly package.
